data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Iērós,' meaning 'god.' The name Ier signifies 'helper of God.' In the Bible, several figures bore this name, including the high priest Eli and the prophet Jeremiah. The name Ier carries the meaning “God's helper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ier usually hope their child will grow to embody god's helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
